Load Data¶

In [2]:
def load_data():
    path = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/refs/heads/master/data/2024/2024-10-29/"
    # read from remote only if local csv not saved yet
    if not os.path.exists("monster_movies.csv"):
        monsters = pd.read_csv(f"{path}/monster_movies.csv")
        monsters.to_csv("monster_movies.csv", index=False)
        genres = pd.read_csv(f"{path}/monster_movie_genres.csv")
        genres.to_csv("monster_movie_genres.csv", index=False)
    monsters = pd.read_csv(f"monster_movies.csv")
    genres = pd.read_csv(f"monster_movie_genres.csv")
    return monsters, genres

monsters,genres = load_data()
monsters.head(20)

Tokenise, PoS and Frequencies > Word Cloud¶

In [6]:
all_titles = " ".join(monsters["simple_title"])
word_tokens = word_tokenize(all_titles)

# Filterout stop words and obvious words
stop_words = set(stopwords.words('english'))
stop_words.add("monster")
stop_words.add("monsters")
filtered_list = [w for w in word_tokens if not w.lower() in stop_words ]

# Part of speech tagging
tokens_pos = pos_tag(filtered_list)

# show only nouns (NN) or verbs (JJ)
tokens = [word for word,pos in tokens_pos if pos == 'JJ']
fdist = FreqDist(tokens)
freqdic = dict(fdist)
freqdic
fdist.plot(10, cumulative=False)

# Word Cloud
monster_mask = np.array(Image.open("monster_mask.png"))

wc = WordCloud( max_words=1000, font_path="Creepster-Regular.ttf", width = 2000, height = 1840, 
               mask=monster_mask, background_color = "black", colormap = "Set3", contour_width = 1, contour_color = "green") #
wc.generate_from_frequencies(freqdic)

# Display the generated image at 1000 x 600 pixels:
plt.figure(figsize = (20, 18))
plt.imshow(wc, interpolation = 'bilinear')
plt.axis("off")
plt.show()
